explanation_full: This chart visualizes the performance of the KNN model in predicting Hydrogen Production Rate (HPR). The KNN model achieved the highest R2 score (0.81717) and lowest MSE (0.012810) among all models, indicating its superior predictive accuracy compared to other models like SVM, DT, RF, and XGBoost.  The chart also shows the actual peak HPR value and the predicted peak value by the KNN model, along with their corresponding indices in the time series data. This information helps understand the model's ability to capture the temporal trends and predict future HPR values effectively.
